 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Item&nbsp;1.01&nbsp;Entry into Material Definitive Agreement. </B></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On October&nbsp;13, 2006, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (the &#147;<B><I>Company</I></B>&#148;), the Company&#146;s indirect wholly-owned subsidiary AMD Fab 36 Limited
Liability Company&nbsp;&amp; Co. KG (&#147;<B><I>AMD Fab 36 KG&#148;</I></B>), the Company&#146;s direct wholly-owned subsidiary AMD Fab 36 Holding GmbH and the other parties thereto executed an Amendment Agreement dated as of October&nbsp;10, 2006
(the &#147;<B><I>Amendment</I></B>&#148;) which amended the terms of the Company&#146;s EUR 700&nbsp;million Term Loan Facility Agreement among AMD Fab 36 KG, as borrower, and a consortium of banks led by Dresdner Bank AG, as lenders, dated
April&nbsp;21, 2004 (the &#147;<B><I>Facility Agreement</I></B>&#148;) and related agreements, including the Guarantee Agreement among the Company, as Guarantor, AMD Fab 36 KG, Dresdner Bank AG and Dresdner Bank AG, Niederlassung Luxemburg (the
&#147;<B><I>Guarantee Agreement</I></B>&#148;). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:2%; text-indent:-2%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Facility Agreement </U></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Under the amended and restated Facility Agreement, AMD Fab 36 KG has the option to borrow in U.S. Dollars as long as the Company&#146;s group consolidated cash (which is
defined as the sum of the Company&#146;s and its subsidiaries&#146; unsecured cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments less the aggregate amount outstanding under any revolving credit facility) is at least $500 million. Moreover, to protect
the lenders from currency risks, if group consolidated cash is below one billion or the Company&#146;s credit rating drops below B3 by Moody&#146;s and B- by Standard&nbsp;&amp; Poor&#146;s, AMD Fab 36 KG will be required to maintain a cash reserve
account with deposits equal to 5 percent of the amount of U.S.&nbsp;Dollar loans outstanding under the Facility Agreement and to make balancing payments into this account equal to the difference between (x)&nbsp;the total amount of U.S.&nbsp;Dollar
loans outstanding under the Facility Agreement and (y)&nbsp;the U.S Dollar equivalent of 700&nbsp;million euros (as reduced by repayments, prepayments, cancellations, and any outstanding loans denominated in euros under the Facility Agreement).
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The amended and restated Facility Agreement also amends certain covenants applicable to AMD Fab 36 KG. For example, for as long as group consolidated cash
is at least one billion, the Company&#146;s credit rating is at least B3 by Moody&#146;s and B- by Standard&nbsp;&amp; Poor&#146;s, and no event of default has occurred, AMD Fab 36 KG is no longer required to maintain minimum cash balances.
Moreover, the only financial covenant that AMD Fab 36 KG is now required to comply with is the loan to fixed asset value covenant. Specifically, the loan to fixed asset value as at the end of any relevant period specified in Column A below can not
exceed the percentage set out opposite such relevant period in Column B below: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" WIDTH="60%" BORDER="0" ALIGN="center">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">As of July&nbsp;2, 2006, AMD Fab 36 KG was in compliance with this covenant. AMD Fab 36 KG&#146;s information
undertakings were also simplified. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:2%; text-indent:-2%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><U>Guarantee Agreement </U></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Under the amended and restated Guarantee Agreement, the financial covenants applicable to the Company were revised. The financial covenant relating to adjusted tangible
net worth was amended such that the definition of &#147;adjusted net earnings from operations&#148; now excludes compensation expense related to awards of equity instruments to employees as well as any amounts reflected in the Company&#146;s
financial statements under the line item &#147;Equity in net income (loss) of Spansion Inc.&#148; The adjusted tangible net worth covenant levels were also amended to reflect the fact that Spansion LLC is no longer a majority owned subsidiary of the
Company. Accordingly, from and after the first date, if any, on which group consolidated cash is less than: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

vis-&agrave;-vis</I> the Security Agent other than as permitted pursuant to Clause 27.6 (<I>No Set-off by the Borrower</I>). </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>SECTION 10 </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ADMINISTRATION </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>27.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>PAYMENT MECHANICS</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">27.1</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Payments to the Facility Agent</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On each date on which an Obligor or a Lender is required to make a payment under a Finance Document, that Obligor (subject to Clause&nbsp;27.9 (<I>Payments to the Security
Agent</I>)) or that Lender shall make the same available to the Facility Agent (unless a contrary indication appears in a Finance Document) for value on the due date at the time and in such funds specified by the Facility Agent as being customary at
the time for settlement of transactions in the relevant currency in the place of payment. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Payment shall be made to such account in the principal financial centre of the country of that currency (or, in relation to EUR or USD, in a principal financial centre in a
Participating Member State or London) with such bank as the Facility Agent specifies. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Distributions by the Facility Agent</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:5%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Each payment
received by the Facility Agent under the Finance Documents for another Party shall, subject to Clause&nbsp;27.3 (<I>Distributions to an Obligor</I>), Clause&nbsp;27.4 (<I>Clawback</I>) and Clause&nbsp;27.9 (<I>Payments to the Security Agent</I>), be
made available by the Facility Agent as soon as practicable after receipt to the Party entitled to receive payment in accordance with this Agreement (in the case of a Lender, for the account of its Facility Office), to such account as that Party may
notify to the Facility Agent by not less than five (5)&nbsp;Business Days&#146; notice with a bank in the principal financial centre of the country of that currency (or, in relation to EUR, in a principal financial centre in a Participating Member
State or London). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

the Security Agent may (with the consent of the Obligor or in accordance with Clause&nbsp;28 (<I>Set-Off</I>)) apply any amount received by it for that Obligor in or towards payment (on the date and in the currency and funds of receipt) of any
amount due from that Obligor under the Finance Documents or in or towards purchase of any amount of any currency to be so applied. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">27.4</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Clawback</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Where a sum is to be paid to the Facility Agent or the Security Agent under the Finance Documents for another Party, the Facility Agent or, as the case may be, the Security Agent is
not obliged to pay that sum to that other Party (or to enter into or perform any related exchange contract) until it has been able to establish to its satisfaction that it has actually received that sum. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P
STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

one or more such means of obtaining payment and discharge of all or any part of the Guarantor&#146;s Liabilities. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>7.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>TAXES</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Guarantor shall (within three (3)&nbsp;Business Days of demand by the Security Agent) pay to the Protected Party an amount equal to the loss, liability or cost that that
Protected Party determines will be or has been (directly or indirectly) suffered for or on account of withholding Tax, stamp duty, registration and other similar Taxes by that Protected Party in respect of a Finance Document.

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">with respect to any Tax assessed on a Lender: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">under the law of the jurisdiction in which that Lender is incorporated or, if different, the jurisdiction (or jurisdictions) in which that Lender is treated as resident for tax
purposes; or </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:15%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">if in either case that Tax is imposed on or calculated by reference to the net income received or receivable (but not any sum deemed to be received or

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">to the extent a loss, liability or cost: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(A)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">is compensated for by an increased payment under Clause 7.2 (<I>Gross-up</I>); or </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(B)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">would have been compensated for by an increased payment under Clause&nbsp;7.2 (<I>Gross-up</I>) but was not so compensated solely because one of the exclusions in paragraph
(d)&nbsp;of Clause 7.2 (<I>Gross-up</I>) applied. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TR>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">A Protected Party making, or intending to make, a claim pursuant to paragraph (a)&nbsp;above shall promptly notify the Security Agent of the event which will give, or has given,
rise to the claim, following which the Security Agent shall notify the Guarantor. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">A Protected Party shall, on receiving a payment from the Guarantor under this Clause&nbsp;7.1, notify the Security Agent. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Guarantor shall make all payments to be made by it without any Tax Deduction, unless a Tax Deduction is required by law. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">the Guarantor is able to demonstrate that the payment could have been made to that Lender without the Tax Deduction had that Lender complied with its obligations under paragraph
(g)&nbsp;below, including timely providing the documents allowing the Guarantor to make the payment without a Tax Deduction. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If the Guarantor is required to make a Tax Deduction, the Guarantor shall make that Tax Deduction and any payment required in connection with that Tax Deduction within the time
allowed and in the minimum amount required by law. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Within thirty (30)&nbsp;days of making either a Tax Deduction or any payment required in connection with that Tax Deduction, the Guarantor shall deliver to the Security Agent for
the Finance Party entitled to the payment evidence reasonably satisfactory to that Finance Party that the Tax Deduction has been made or (as applicable) any appropriate payment has been paid to the relevant taxing authority.
</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">A Lender and the Guarantor shall co-operate in completing any procedural formalities necessary for the Guarantor to obtain authorisation to make a payment to that Lender without a

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If the Guarantor makes a Tax Payment and the relevant Lender determines that: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">a Tax Credit is attributable either to an increased payment of which that Tax Payment forms part, or to that Tax Payment; and </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P
STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">that Lender has obtained, utilised and retained that Tax Credit, or could have obtained, utilised or retained that Tax Credit had it claimed such benefit according to the applicable
procedural rules within the provisions of paragraph (c)&nbsp;below, </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:6%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">the Lender shall pay an amount to the Guarantor which

reasonable endeavours (to the extent commercially practicable and legally permitted) to recover such Tax Credit. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If such a Tax Credit by reference to which a Lender has made a payment to the Guarantor under paragraph (a)&nbsp;above is subsequently disallowed or cancelled, the Guarantor must

an adverse effect on its business, operations, property, condition or prospects (financial or otherwise). The Guarantor shall bear any costs incurred by a Lender in making such a claim. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Each Original Lender confirms to the Guarantor, the Security Agent and the Facility Agent on the date of this Guarantee Agreement that it is a Qualifying Lender.
</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>8.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>CURRENCY INDEMNITY</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:6%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If any amount is received by
the Security Agent in a currency other than that in which the relevant obligation or liability of the Guarantor was payable (the &#147;<B>Required Currency</B>&#148;) (whether pursuant to a judgment, in the Insolvency of the Guarantor or otherwise),
such obligation or liability shall be discharged only to the extent that an Agent is able, upon receipt of such amount, to purchase the Required Currency with such other currency in accordance with the usual banking procedures of the Security Agent.
If the amount in the Required Currency which may be so purchased is, after deducting any costs of exchange and any other related costs, less than the amount of the relevant obligation or liability, the Guarantor shall, as a separate and independent
obligation and notwithstanding any time or other indulgence granted to the Guarantor or any other act, matter or thing, forthwith pay to the Security Agent the amount of the shortfall. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TR>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>9.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>CLAIMS BY GUARANTOR</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
